# Freerouting DSN corpus fixture

`freerouting_issue269_minimal_v2_3_0.dsn` is copied semantically unchanged
from `freerouting/freerouting` tag `v2.3.0`, path
`fixtures/Issue269-min_fr_test/min_fr_test.dsn`; repeated whitespace and
single-clause line breaks are compacted only to keep the fixture reviewable.

It is an engine-owned parser corpus fixture used to ensure Copperpour's Specctra
dependency accepts syntax emitted and maintained by Freerouting. Freerouting is
licensed under GPL-3.0; Copperpour is AGPL-3.0.
